en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 5. My father narrated to me from Aḥmad ibn Idrīs, from ‘Amraki, from Sandal, from Abil Sabbāḥ Al-Kināni, who said: Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said:

On the night of Qadr, “wherein every affair of wisdom is made distinct” [44:4], a caller will call out from inside the Throne, “Verily Allāh has forgiven everyone who has come to the Ziyārah of the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.) on this night.”
